feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Supreme Court upholds pause on Trump's anti-trans prison policy
entry.summary: The Supreme Court ruled Wednesday that the Trump administration has to continue providing gender-affirming care to inmates in federal prisons as litigation on efforts to change the policy continues.

entry.title: New human data hints at psychedelics' potential to combat inflammation
entry.summary: Lab studies have shown that psychedelics like psilocybin can lower inflammation and may be protective for a range of illnesses. Now, researchers are publishing some of the first data in humans that signals this holds potential for patients with neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson's disease.

entry.title: Sentenced to death at 17, at 68, quilt artist receives solo museum exhibition
entry.summary: A quilt artist who spent decades on death row now has his first solo exhibit at the Grand Rapids Art Museum.

entry.title: Israel detains dozens of Americans, including a congressional candidate, in West Bank
entry.summary: Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander along with about 80 American and Israeli rabbis and activists were helping Palestinian olive harvesters when they were detained by Israeli forces.

entry.title: Trump leans into unprecedented power ahead of midterm elections
entry.summary: Less than two weeks before the election, Trump continues to crash through barriers that he wouldn't dare cross in his first term.

entry.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request
entry.summary: The announcement of Hubbard's release came as talks got underway between Putin and White House envoy Steve Witkoff in Saint Petersburg focused on the latest U.S. efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: 2025 policing trend: Fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests
entry.summary: Arrests for more minor offenses, including vagrancy, rose in the U.S., even as violent crime rates dropped to historic lows, according to an analysis from criminal justice reform advocacy group FWD.us

entry.title: How much does pregnancy cost? Be prepared with these tips
entry.summary: The cost of having a baby is difficult to predict. The amount families pay varies widely. Here are five tips to help you prepare for the often unexpected costs of pregnancy and giving birth.

entry.title: Millions are struck off India's voter rolls in largest disenfranchisement in history
entry.summary: India is plunged into political crisis after 130 million names were struck off voter rolls during a massive revision.

entry.title: LeBron James talks smack with Knicks fans in victorious 76ers debut
entry.summary: The Sixers got a first look at the potent lineup they put together this summer in hopes of winning their first title since 1983.
